dataList.displayName:
红宝石之心
 Red Ruby Heart
dataList.description:
曾经承载着快乐衣橱继续存在之愿的容器。
 The vessel that once held the Happy Closet's wish to go on existing.

dataList.displayName:
飘散粉红花瓣的异想体之卵
 The Egg of an Abnormality that Scattered Pink Petals
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，使用<color=#F8C200>普通攻击</color>命中敌人时，施加<color=#F8C200>花瓣标记</color>
- 仅在敌人没有此<color=#F8C200>标记</color>时施加该效果
- <color=#F8C200>花瓣标记</color>持续10秒
- 花瓣标记冷却时间：10秒（从施加标记时开始计算）
- 默尔索的<color=#F8C200>普通攻击</color>对带有花瓣标记的目标造成+1<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
- 带有此标记的目标被击败时，以目标为中心，对3×3格范围造成5点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
 In the Symbolic, when landing a hit using <color=#F8C200>Basic Attack</color> on the enemy, inflict <color=#F8C200>Petal Mark</color>
- This effect is inflicted only when the enemy does not have this <color=#F8C200>Mark</color>
- <color=#F8C200>Petal Mark</color> lasts for 10 seconds
- Petal Mark cooldown: 10 seconds (counts from the moment the mark is inflicted)
- Meursault's <color=#F8C200>Basic Attack</color> deals +1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> against targets inflicted with Petal Mark
- When a target that has this mark is defeated, deal 5 <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> on 3 x 3 tiles centered on the target
dataList.description:
百货商场里的每一位顾客与员工，都已经在经历各自的扭曲。既然扭曲的终点是异想体，那么这里没有出现任何异想体，反倒才是真正的异常。
 Every customer and employee in the department store is already undergoing their own Distortion. Since the terminus of Distortion is an Abnormality, the true abnormality would be if no Abnormalities had appeared here.

dataList.displayName:
黄金纽扣
 Golden Button
dataList.description:
用黄金松脂制成的纽扣。
 A button fashioned from Golden Resin.

dataList.displayName:
黄金牙齿
 Golden Tooth
dataList.description:
用黄金皮革缝合起来的牙齿。
 A tooth stitched together with Golden Hide.

dataList.displayName:
黄金发丝
 Golden Hair
dataList.description:
被抽成缕缕金丝的头发。
 Hair drawn out into strands of gold.

dataList.displayName:
赤红尖钉
 Red Nail
dataList.description:
一名苦苦等待声音的员工的脊椎骨。钉子用于固定事物。骨头将血肉固定在原位。骨头就是钉子。钉子如针一般刺穿事物。这截脊椎不仅是一枚上好的钉子，也是一根针。
 The vertebra of an employee who waited desperately for the Voice. A nail exists to hold things fast. Bone holds flesh in place. Bone is a nail. A nail pierces like a needle. This vertebra is not only a quality nail but also a needle.

dataList.displayName:
信念
 Faith
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，受到足以致死的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>时，有10%概率以1点<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>存活
- 即死等特定伤害除外

象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+2
 In the Symbolic, upon taking <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> that would result in death, 10% chance to survive with 1 <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>
- Excluding certain damages such as Instant Death

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2
dataList.description:
“信就是所望之事的实底，是未见之事的确据。”
 "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen."

dataList.displayName:
粉红玛丽珍鞋
 Pink Mary Janes
dataList.statText:
在阴影界战斗期间，布布的脉动威力+1
- 速度下限与上限+3
- “赤红尖钉”硬币+1（使用追加硬币命中时，发射<color=#F8C200>花瓣弹体</color>）
- 使用“打起精神”技能时，每拥有2点脉动威力，攻击加权值+1（最多+2）
- 解放“牵住我的手”技能（有友方陷入混乱时自动使用，使其<color=#F8C200>解除混乱</color>并<color=#00ff9c>回复</color><color=#00ff9c>体力</color>；每回合2次）
 Pwie's Pulsation Potency +1 during battle in the Shadowed
- Min & Max Speed +3
- "Crimson Nail" Coin +1 (On Hit using additional Coins, fire <color=#F8C200>Petal Projectiles</color>)
- Upon using the "Perk Up" Skill, gain +1 Atk Weight for every 2 Pulsation Potency (max 2)
- Unlock the "Grab My Hand" Skill (used automatically when an ally is Staggered to <color=#F8C200>recover them from Stagger</color> and <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> their <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>; 2 times per turn)
dataList.description:
能将任何人带回家的鞋。每一步散发的余香都浸透着思慕，因为穿上它的人会开始向往离家最遥远的地方。毕竟，对家的思念越深，便必然越接近归途。
 Shoes that bring anyone home. The faint aroma scattered by each footfall is steeped in longing, for whoever wears them begins to yearn for the farthest place from home. After all, the more one longs for home, the closer to home one inevitably draws.

dataList.displayName:
黄金裹布
 Golden Shroud
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，布布会在经过之处留下<color=#F8C200>呕吐物</color>
- 布布1格内的敌人与站在<color=#F8C200>呕吐物</color>上的敌人每2秒受到4点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>
- 对所有因此效果受到<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>的敌人施加<color=#F8C200>黄金启示</color>
- 带有<color=#F8C200>黄金启示</color>的敌人死亡时，对其周围1格内造成4点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）

在阴影界战斗期间：
- 布布获得1点脉动威力
- 防御等级+10
- 回合结束：若布布陷入混乱，则解除混乱并<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>50%<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>（每场遭遇战1次）
- 使用“赤红尖钉（第2枚硬币）”、“走开”或“赤红尖钉之洗礼”命中时，施加1层<color=#F8C200>黄金启示</color>
- 使用“赤红尖钉之洗礼”时，若脉动威力达到5点以上，则攻击加权值+2，硬币威力提升（脉动威力-3）
- 使用“不要受伤”时，额外<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>（脉动威力×2）%<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>与（脉动威力×3）精神力
- 使用“牵住我的手”命中时，下回合为目标施加等同于其<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>上限50%的护盾
 In the Symbolic, Pwie leaves <color=#F8C200>Le Vomissement</color> in their tracks
- Enemies 1 tile within Pwie and enemies on top of <color=#F8C200>Le Vomissement</color> take 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> every 2 seconds
- Inflicts <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color> on all enemies who took <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> from this effect
- When enemies that have <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color> dies, they deal 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile around them (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

During battle in the Shadowed:
- Pwie gains 1 Pulsation Potency
- Defense Level +10
- Turn End: If Pwie is Staggered, recover from Stagger and <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> 50% <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> (once per Encounter)
- On Hit using "Crimson Nail (2nd Coin)", "Go Away", or "Baptism of Crimson Nails", inflict 1 <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color>
- On "Baptism of Crimson Nails" use, at 5+ Pulsation Potency, gain +2 Atk Weight and Coin Power +(Pulsation Potency - 3)
- Upon using "Don't Get Hurty", additionally <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> (Pulsation Potency x 2)% <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> and (Pulsation Potency x 3) SP
- On Hit using "Grab My Hand", apply Shield equal to 50% of target's max <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> next turn
dataList.description:
保留着黄金皮革毛皮的羊剪绒斗篷。这件衣物将外来之物拒之门外，同时催促内在之物绽放。孩子披上它的那一刻，童年便宣告结束。孩子学会他人有何期待、什么必须复原，并被迫依此行事。其不再被允许对世界怀有好奇。
 A shearling cape that preserves the fur of the Golden Hide. This garment keeps what comes from outside at bay, while hastening what blooms within. Once the child dons it, childhood reaches its end. The child learns what others expect and what must be restored, and is compelled to act accordingly. It is no longer permitted to be curious about the world.

dataList.displayName:
生皮捆
 Bundle of Rawhide
dataList.description:
血肉从骨骼上剥离，皮则从血肉上揭下。随后，必须将附着其上的毛发溶解殆尽，直到只剩生皮。
 As flesh is stripped from bone, hide is peeled from flesh. Then the hair clinging to it must be dissolved away until only the raw skin remains.

dataList.displayName:
鞣制皮革
 Tanned Hide
dataList.description:
皮革在制革厂中经单宁转化，呈现出棕褐色。
 Hide takes on the color of tan as tannins transform it inside the Tannery.

dataList.displayName:
柔韧皮革
 Supple Hide
dataList.description:
皮革是肉转化为植物的过程。血肉溶解，木质枝条填满其留下的空洞。
 Hide is the process by which meat becomes plant. The flesh dissolves, and branches of wood fill the hollows left behind.

dataList.displayName:
改造工具
 Alteration Tools
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，解放<color=#F8C200>监督者弹体</color>
- 向5格内随机一名敌人发射（冷却时间2.5秒）
- 命中目标时，对其周围1格内造成3点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>（0.1秒受击硬直）

在阴影界战斗中，为布布解放“我来替你结束……”
- 敌人未被攻击技能击杀时，对该敌人使用（每回合1次）
- 目标每损失1%<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>，造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+0.5%（最多30%）
 In the Symbolic, unlock <color=#F8C200>Overseer Projectiles</color>
- Fired to a random enemy within 5 tiles (2.5 seconds cooldown)
- On hitting the target, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

In Shadowed Battles, unlock "I'll End It for You..." for Pwie
- If an enemy is not killed by an Attack Skill, use it on that enemy (once per turn)
- Deal +0.5% <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> for every 1% missing <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> on target (max 30%)
dataList.description:
红派渴求皮革的理由很简单。皮革意味着耗竭；织物意味着过剩。他们吃掉肉，再穿上剩余之物，从不思考食物被吃尽后会发生什么。现在就吃。现在就穿。红派崇拜耗竭。他们并非因为热爱皮革才走向耗竭。他们之所以穿上皮革，是因为耗竭从一开始就是它的归宿。
 The reason the Rouges desire hide is simple. Hide is depletion; fabric is excess. They eat the meat, then wear what remains, never wondering what happens when nothing is left to eat. Consume now. Wear now. The Rouges worship depletion. They do not walk toward depletion because they love hide. They came to wear hide because depletion was always its destination.

dataList.displayName:
黄金皮革织物
 Golden Hide Fabric
dataList.description:
如此说来，黄金皮革可以被描述为一种结构中密集塞满微小黄金束的皮革。曾经填补裂隙的皮，的确是某个人的皮肤与血肉。而在经过鞣制后，它获得了与金枝相称的树木性质。

但金枝真的曾被确定为植物吗？
 The Golden Hide, then, could be described as a hide whose very structure is densely packed with minute bundles of gold. The Hide that once filled the cracks truly had been someone's skin and flesh. And once it was tanned, it came to take on arboreal properties befitting the Golden Bough.

But was the Golden Bough ever truly established to be a plant?

dataList.displayName:
幼虫
 Larva
dataList.description:
百货商场建成之前，一个古老的存在奇迹般幸存下来，并留下了后代。那名幸存的子嗣搁浅在岸边，将在那里成为新时代的材料。
 Before the department store was built, a being of eld survived as if by miracle and left behind an offspring. That surviving descendant was beached on the Shore, there to become material for a new age.

dataList.displayName:
灯火
 The Lights
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，静止不动时受到攻击，承受的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>-2（最低承受1点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>）
 In the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -2 when hit while standing still (min 1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> taken)
dataList.description:
它嫉妒太阳的光辉，于是成为了一盏灯。然而灯必须比太阳更贴近人们，因为太阳过于耀眼、炽热，无法留在身边。
 Envious of the sun's radiance, it became a lamp. Yet a lamp must stay closer to people than the sun, because the sun is too dazzling and hot to keep at one's side.

dataList.displayName:
是焦香，听清楚了吗？
 It's Toasty, You Hear?
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，击杀敌人时<color=#00ff9c>回复</color>3点象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>（冷却时间4秒）
 In the Symbolic, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 3 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> upon killing an enemy (4 seconds cooldown)
dataList.description:
焦香是一种香气，不是味道，听清楚了吗？香气和味道并不相同，可它们总是黏在一起，听清楚了吗？总有一天，我要做一道只由香气构成的菜，听清楚了吗？那样一来，这里的所有人都能吃饱，再也不用担心食物耗尽，听清楚了吗？
 Toasty is an aroma, not a flavor, you hear? Aroma and taste are different, but they cling together, you hear? Someday, I'll cook a dish made only of aroma, you hear?  Then everyone here can have their fill without worrying about food running out, you hear?

dataList.displayName:
是鲜味，听清楚了吗？
 It's Savory, You Hear?
dataList.statText:
象征界中的<color=#fe4b48>攻击速度</color>+15%
 <color=#fe4b48>Attack Speed</color> +15% in the Symbolic
dataList.description:
鲜味很能勾起食欲，听清楚了吗？一旦有了食欲，就会开始渴望下一道菜，听清楚了吗？渴望下一道菜，就意味着期待下一种味道，听清楚了吗？所以，鲜味就意味着期待，听清楚了吗？
 Savory flavor really brings up the appetite, you hear? Once you feel that appetite, you start craving the next dish, you hear? Craving the next dish means looking forward to the next flavor, you hear? So, savory means anticipation, you hear?

dataList.displayName:
红派快销服饰单肩包
 Le Rouge Casualwear Shoulder Bag
dataList.statText:
象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+3
 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +3
dataList.description:
你尝过塞在裂隙里的黄金皮革吗？哦，用那种皮革调味的衣服……那可是永远无法忘怀的味道。
 Have you ever tasted the Golden Hide packed into the cracks? Oh, clothes seasoned with that hide... now that is a flavor one can never forget.

dataList.displayName:
红派快销服饰连帽衫
 Le Rouge Casualwear Hoodie
dataList.statText:
象征界中造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+1
 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1 in the Symbolic
dataList.description:
有时候，啃食黄金皮革会让裂隙变得更宽。这种时候，就抓住那些企图控制皮革的讨厌黑派，把他们塞进缺口，堵严实……瞧，问题解决了。
 Sometimes, gnawing away at the Golden Hide makes the crack wider. When that happens, you catch these nasty Noirs who tried to control the Hide. Stuff them into the gap, plug it up... And voilà, problem solved.

dataList.displayName:
红派现代服饰帽
 Le Rouge Contemporary Cap
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，解放<color=#F8C200>闪避</color>
- 按下<color=#F8C200>闪避键（键盘Z键）</color>，向移动方向<color=#F8C200>闪避</color>1格；静止时则向当前朝向闪避（冷却时间0.5秒）
- <color=#F8C200>闪避</color>会触发0.2秒<color=#F8C200>无敌帧</color>，攻击期间也可发动
 In the Symbolic, unlocks <color=#F8C200>Evade</color>
- Press the <color=#F8C200>Evade button (Z on keyboard)</color> to <color=#F8C200>Evade</color> 1 tile in the direction of movement, or the direction currently faced while stationary (0.5 seconds cooldown)
- <color=#F8C200>Evade</color> triggers <color=#F8C200>Invul. Frame</color> for 0.2 seconds and can also be activated during attacks
dataList.description:
曾有人疑惑：“西西弗百货建成之前，这里矗立着什么？”这个念头很快被放进一顶帽子，从此沉没不见。
 Someone once wondered, "What stood here before the Grand Magasin was built?" The thought was soon placed inside a cap, where it sank out of sight.

dataList.displayName:
红派现代服饰手套
 Le Rouge Contemporary Gloves
dataList.statText:
象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+3
 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +3
dataList.description:
黄金皮革既可食用，也可穿戴。皮革就是血肉本身；它确确实实活着、呼吸着。它与我们身体上的皮肤并无不同。
 The Golden Hide may be consumed or worn. Hide is flesh itself; it quite literally lives and breathes. It is no different from the skin of our own bodies.

dataList.displayName:
黑派现代服饰长袜
 Le Noir Contemporary Long Socks
dataList.statText:
在象征界中解放2级<color=#F8C200>防御</color>
- <color=#F8C200>防御</color>时间：2.5秒
- <color=#F8C200>防御</color><color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>：象征界攻击<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2
 Unlocks Level 2 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> in the Symbolic
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> Time: 2.5 seconds
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>: Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> +2 in the Symbolic
dataList.description:
哦，裂隙正在闭合。封住缺口的是黄金——黄金松脂。
 Oh, the crack is closing. Sealing the breach is the gold—the Resin of Gold.

dataList.displayName:
黑派现代服饰领带夹
 Le Noir Contemporary Tiepin
dataList.statText:
在象征界中解放<color=#F8C200>完美格挡</color>
- 触发条件：按下<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>键后的0.3秒内，朝<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>方向进行<color=#F8C200>格挡</color>，使承受的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>降至0

 Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Perfect Block</color> in the Symbolic
- Trigger Condition: Within 0.3 seconds of pressing the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> button, <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> in the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> direction reduces incoming <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 0
dataList.description:
保护黄金松脂。反过来，黄金松脂也保护西西弗百货免于崩塌。一条简单的因果链。
 Protect the Golden Resin. The Golden Resin, in turn, keeps the Grand Magasin from collapsing. A simple chain of cause and effect.

dataList.displayName:
黑派鞋履馆布洛克鞋
 Le Noir Footwear Hall Wingtip Shoes
dataList.statText:
在象征界中，使用2级以上<color=#F8C200>防御</color>时触发向前3格的<color=#F8C200>突进</color>
- 路径被障碍物阻挡时提前停止
 In the Symbolic, using Level 2 or higher <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> triggers <color=#F8C200>Dash</color> 3 tiles forward
- Stops early if an obstacle blocks the path
dataList.description:
鞋必须毫无差错地保护穿戴者。它必须让人稳稳直立于大地，不偏不倚、毫不动摇。世界危机四伏；立于不稳的地面时，鞋便是稳定的最后堡垒。
 A shoe must protect its wearer without fault. It must hold them upright upon the earth, steady and unshaken. The world is dangerous; on unstable ground, the shoe is the final bastion of stability.

dataList.displayName:
黑派鞋履馆鞋油
 Le Noir Footwear Hall Shoe Polish
dataList.statText:
象征界<color=#F8C200>防御</color>速度+25%
 Symbolic <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> Speed +25%
dataList.description:
护理说明：黑派鞋履由石头制成。石鞋坚硬且不会破裂，但很容易出现划痕，因此必须用鞋油掩盖痕迹。划痕严重的鞋显得陈旧；显旧的鞋看起来结构脆弱，而看起来结构脆弱的鞋便可能破裂。
 Care Instructions: Noir shoes are made of stone. Stone shoes are hard and do not break. However, they scratch easily, so you must conceal marks with polish. Heavily scratched shoes look old; old-looking shoes appear structurally fragile, and structurally fragile-looking shoes may break.

dataList.displayName:
糊状诱饵
 Paste Bait
dataList.statText:
象征界<color=#00ff9c>体力</color>+4

他们转动纺车，纺出丝线。

他们如此劳作了太久，以至于因果本身也扭曲并卷入自身。是为了转动纺车而纺线，还是为了纺线而转动纺车？这个问题已经无法回答，但并不重要。在这一层，“为什么”无足轻重。楼层经理的职责始于且终于一个单一功能：纺出丝线，并将其交给收取者。因此，即使纺线者死去，纺车也不会停止。丝线在此等待尖钉到来，将此处与彼处系在一起。

They have done so for so long that causality itself has warped into itself. Does one spin thread to turn the wheel, or turn the wheel to spin thread? The question has become unanswerable, but it does not matter. On this floor, the "why" is of little significance. The Floor Manager's role begins and ends with a singular function: to spin thread and give it to its recipient. Thus, the spinning wheel does not stop even when the spinners die. The thread waits here for the arrival of the nail, to tether the here to the there.

水族箱曾容纳无数鱼类与各式水槽。鳞片、水流与玻璃围栏贯穿形形色色的环境。最底层流淌着由黑之丝编织而成的水，其中有一条鱼静静沉睡。
 The Aquarium once held countless fish and tanks of every kind. Scales, waters, and glass enclosures threaded through environments of every variety. Lowest of all flowed water woven from Blackthread, and within it slept a fish in silence.

dataList.description:
水族箱转变为西西弗百货时，水族箱的一切残余本应随之消失。然而，仍有某物留了下来——某个依旧记得自己曾在那里度过的时光之物。对长期被认为毫无缺陷的西西弗系统而言，这是必须修正的缺陷。

不知为何，那条未曾成为顾客便被遗留下来的鱼，无论西西弗百货重置多少次，都仍将是一条鱼。

要修正西西弗系统中的这一缺陷，负责那条鱼的罪人便必须死去。

但西西弗系统既是惩罚装置、资源收集设备，也是N公司道德观的具现。依照设计，它无法强行杀死自己的囚犯。
 When the Aquarium transformed into the Grand Magasin, every remnant of the Aquarium should have disappeared with it. Yet something remained—something that still remembers its time there. For the Sisyphe System, which had long been believed to be flawless, this is a defect that must be resolved.

For whatever reason, the fish that was left behind without ever becoming a customer will remain a fish, no matter how many times the Grand Magasin resets.

To correct this flaw within the Sisyphe System, the Sinner responsible for that fish would have to die.

But the Sisyphe System is at once a punishment device, a resource-harvesting apparatus, and an embodiment of N Corp.'s morality. By design, it cannot forcibly kill one of its own prisoners.

味道……有那么重要吗？你又不知道蠕蠕好不好吃。如果你无论如何都想吃蠕蠕……你以前吃过蠕蠕吗？可是……味道一直都在变化。你为什么觉得蠕蠕还会和以前一样好吃？而且……蠕蠕就在这里。根本没人吃过蠕蠕。真奇怪……
 Is taste... that important? You don't know if Wriggley's gonna be tasty or not. If you wanna eat Wriggley anyway... have you eaten Wriggley before? But... taste is changing all the time. Why do you think Wriggley'll taste the same again? And... Wriggley's right here. No one's eaten Wriggley. Weird...

 ... I don't understand. You tried to kill Meursault, Dante, and me when we first met. I need something from you... but you won't give it, so there's really no other way, right? You die because... because you're evil... And weak, too. So why do I feel so awful? You did the same thing—Why... why am I the only one left to feel this guilt?

dataList.description:
不属于百货商场的某物留下的烟灰。

西西弗系统随着时代变迁一次又一次改变形态。西西弗百货不过是其一名巨人——也就是同时身为改造师的建筑师——认为最便于在象征界中实现、也最适合实现的形态。

依据被指派到这一职位的人选，西西弗系统可以化作百货商场、水族箱、加油站、洞窟、山脉，或完全不同的其他事物。

它是百货商场还是洞窟并不重要。无论采取何种形态，西西弗系统总会在内部构建某种制造“落差”或波动的手段。巨人所需要的，只是一个能够想象这种结构的视角。
 Soot left behind by something that does not belong to the department store.

The Sisyphe System has changed its form time and again with each passing age. Grand Magasin Sisyphe is simply the form one of its Giants—namely the Architect, who was also an Alterationist—deemed the most convenient and suitable for realization within the Symbolic.

Depending on who is assigned to this position, the Sisyphe System may take the form of a department store, an aquarium, a gas station, a cave, a mountain range, or something else entirely.

Whether it is a department store or a cave is beside the point. Whatever shape it takes, the Sisyphe System will always construct some means of creating a "drop", or fluctuations, within itself. All the Giant needs is a perspective capable of imagining such a structure.

dataList.description:
线与针。地下2层因这两个概念的需要而建成。

线试图穿入针中，而针渴望被穿入。要触及本质，自身也必须贴近本质；因此，越深入地下，存在的清晰度就越会模糊并分裂，直至被还原为零碎片段的集合。
线与针的概念确实十分接近衣物的本质，却并不等同于本质。操纵丝线的改造师走向溶解，是不可避免的命运。
 Thread and needle. B2F was built from the need for these two concepts.

Thread seeks to penetrate the needle, while the needle longs to be penetrated. To handle the essence, one must draw close to the essence oneself; therefore, the deeper one descends to the basement, the clarity of existence blurs and segments until it is reduced to a collection of bits.
Though the concept of thread and needle does, indeed, approach the essence of clothing closely, it is not the same as the essence. The dissolving of the Alterationist, who handles thread, is an inevitable fate.

dataList.displayName:

 A Noir's Note
dataList.statText:

“我在袭击者中看见了红派的品牌总监。她将一枚卵抱在胸前。我能感觉到——从中散发出的微弱神圣暖意。啊……我想我或许明白，她屠杀我们所有人究竟是为了达成什么……”
 "I saw the Rouges' Brand Director among the raiders. She held an egg against her chest. I could feel it—the faint, godly warmth that spread from within it.  Ah... I think I may understand what she slaughtered us all to accomplish..."

 Blossom Scissors

在象征界中，攻击命中时有30%概率触发造成5点<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>的<color=#F8C200>花剪咔嚓追加攻击</color>（0.3秒受击硬直）

dataList.description: 无论你去往何处，我都会用这把花剪咔嚓、咔嚓地一路剪下去，直到你脚下的道路开满飘落的花朵。 Wherever you go, I will snip-snip with these blossom shears until the path beneath you blooms with fallen blossoms.

dataList.displayName:

 Palette's Golden Resin
dataList.description:
黄金皮革是力量之物。心灵或许会摇摇欲坠地走向人台，但黄金皮革会赋予其意识，引导其成为完整的扭曲。
 The Golden Hide is an object of power. Minds may teeter on the brink of descent into a Mannequin, yet the Golden Hide gives them consciousness, guiding them to become a complete Distortion.

dataList.displayName:
地下2层楼层经理的黄金皮革
 B2F Floor Manager's Golden Hide
dataList.description:
抵达终点的扭曲会获得一种只有自己能够理解的语言。它无法以这种语言与他者交流。
 A Distortion that has reached the terminus acquires a language only it can understand. It cannot communicate with others with such a language.

dataList.displayName:
针线之王的黄金皮革
 Golden Hide of the King of Needleworks
dataList.description:
尽管漫长岁月流逝，它却没有退化成人台；相反，在黄金皮革的帮助下，它仍保持着具有智慧的扭曲形态。
 Though ages passed, it did not devolve into a Mannequin; instead, aided by the Golden Hide, it remained a sapient Distortion.

dataList.displayName:
副主厨的黄金皮革
 Sous Chef's Golden Hide
dataList.description:
为什么从黄金皮革中渗出的光，会成为维系人台智慧的锚点？它难道不该加速其堕落为失去心智的扭曲吗？
 Why does the light, bleeding out of the Golden Hide, act as an anchor to the Mannequins' sapience? Should it not instead hasten their descent into mindless Distortions?

dataList.displayName:
尸堆中的黄金皮革
 Golden Hide from the Corpse Pile
dataList.description:
矛盾的是，金色光芒希望所有扭曲都抵达终点，却又同时不希望如此。
栖居于光中的并非单一实体，而其中某个实体内的心也同样不止一个。
 Paradoxically, the golden light wishes for all Distortions to reach their terminus, and at the same time, it does not.
What dwells within the light is more than a single entity, and neither is the heart inside one of them.

dataList.displayName:
红派品牌总监的黄金皮革
 Le Rouge Brand Director's Golden Hide
dataList.description:
扭曲可以保持智慧，并通过各种交流途径向他者传达自己的意志。
光并未抹除其智慧，这实在讽刺，或许也泄露了仍栖居于光中的一丝人性。
 Distortions can remain sapient and convey their wills to others through various avenues of communication.
That the light does not obliterate their wisdom is an irony, and may betray a glimpse of the humanity still dwelling within it.

dataList.displayName:
3层楼层经理的黄金皮革
 3F Floor Manager's Golden Hide
dataList.description:
通过与光对话，持有一片黄金皮革的顾客获得了超越他人的力量，使他们得以将影响力扩展到西西弗百货各处。
 Through dialogue with the light, customers who carried a piece of the Golden Hide gained powers beyond those of others, which allowed them to expand their influence throughout the Grand Magasin.

dataList.displayName:

dataList.description:
虚无派的目的不止是解构这座百货商场。
他们渴望毫无阻碍地完全拥抱光。
 Le Néant's purpose goes beyond the deconstruction of this department store.
They desire the full, unhindered embrace of the light.

西西弗系统是一套为了高效且非暴力地从囚犯身上提取经验而建造的装置。囚犯在其中经历众多体验，其多样性会成为经验面团的基础原料。经验是对变化的感知：静止与运动之间不间断的交替。黑派掌管静止。
 The Sisyphe System is an apparatus built to extract experience from prisoners efficiently and without violence. Within it, prisoners undergo a multitude of experiences, and the variety becomes the base ingredient of Experience Dough. Experience is the perception of change: an unbroken alternation between stillness and motion. Le Noir governs stillness.

- <color=#F8C200>攻击连段2</color>：对敌人造成的<color=#fe4b48>伤害</color>+2，<color=#F8C200>受击硬直</color>+0.1秒

人们常说要体验当下。然而，若经验是预见即将发生之事并目睹其实现的行为，那么经验便必然永远存在于未来。
 People speak of experiencing the present. Yet if experience is the act of anticipating what is to come and seeing it realized, then it must always lie in the future.
